subject: Osteoporosis Drugs Linked to Lower Dementia Risk in Major Study
script: From Agewell Brief: Osteoporosis Drugs Linked to Lower Dementia Risk in Major Study. A comprehensive population study of 120,000 patients reveals that common nitrogen-containing bisphosphonates are associated with a significant reduction in Alzheimer's disease and related dementias. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
